data.one_liner: Extension on String to convert between many common case styles
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of extension methods that transform a string into camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, param-case, CONSTANT_CASE, and other common naming conventions. It also includes utilities for checking case and swapping capitalization.
use_when: You need to format identifiers or display strings in different naming conventions
You want a lightweight, dependency‑free helper for case conversion in Dart code
avoid_when: You need a full text‑processing library with regex customization beyond case conversion
You are already using a code‑generation tool that handles naming conventions
strengths: Supports a wide range of case styles out of the box
Simple extension methods keep code readable
weaknesses: Limited to string case conversion only
No advanced regex customization without modifying config
No support for locale‑specific casing rules
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:change_case/change_case.dart'; no build_runner or permissions required
